name: SikaGrout-9610
paste:
SIKAGROUT®-9610: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaGrout®-9610, October 2025, Version 03.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/7/sikagrout-9610.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaGrout®-9610 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (October 2025, Version 03.01).
1.2 Product description. SikaGrout®-9610 is a ready-to-use, shrinkage-compensated, homogeneous, flowable, and pumpable high-performance cementitious (HPC) grout for offshore, marine and civil infrastrucres. Incorporating advanced nano-engineered binder technology with a blend of Portland, pozzolan, and special cements, SikaGrout®-9610 achieves superior technical performance and exceptional rheological properties. Anti-washout properties and low water permeability make this grout particularly effective for offshore and marine structure grouting and other demanding applications involving narrow constrictions and complex filling needs.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. SikaGrout®-9610 has been especially formulated for large scale, pump applications.
    - Grouting of pile-sleeve connections of offshore jacket foundations
    - Grouting of bolted monopile/transition piece skirt annuli
    - Grouting of mooring and berthing dolphins for marine terminals
    - Grouting of piled pier and jetty structures
    - General purpose grouting for civil infrastructures
    Contact the Technical Department of your local Sika office regarding any application required not mentioned here

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaGrout®-9610
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Shrinkage-compensated and high-performance cementitious grout with advanced nano-engineered technology for offshore, marine and civil infrastructure applications
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (October 2025, Version 03.01) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - EN 12390-7: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Product Information > Density (p.2).
    - EN 1015-11: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Compressive strength (p.2); Technical Information > Flexural-strength (p.2).
    - EN 12390-13: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Modulus of elasticity in compression (p.2).
    - ASTM C469: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Modulus of elasticity in compression (p.2).
    - ASTM C307: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Tensile strength (p.2).
    - ASTM C940: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Bleeding (p.2).
    - ASTM C1202: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Chloride ion permeability (p.2).
    - ASTM C1437: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Application Information > Flowability (p.3).
    - EN 13395-2: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Application Information > Flowability (p.3).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Good flowability
    - High early strength
    - Shrinkage compensated
    - No segregation or bleeding to ensure consistent final physical performance
    - Wide range of application between 2 to 40oC without special precautions
    - Volume stable
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: SikaGrout®-9610 has a C3A content of approximately 3.1-3.4% by mass of dry powder
    - Density: 2.27 - 2.33 ton/m³ (EN 12390-7)
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Total chloride ion content: < 0.01 %
    - Modulus of elasticity in compression: > 30.000 N/mm²; Poisson's ratio: 0.20 (EN 12390-13) (ASTM C469)
    - Flexural-strength: > 11.0 N/mm² (EN 1015-11)
    - Tensile strength: > 6.0 N/mm² (ASTM C307)
    - Bleeding: 0 % (No bleeding) (ASTM C940)
    - Chloride ion permeability: < 2000 (Low penetrability) (ASTM C1202)
2.7 Compressive strength.
    | Age | N/mm² |
    | 1 day | > 35 |
    | 3 days | > 55 |
    | 7 days | > 60 |
    | 28 days | > 80 |
    | 91 days | > 85 |
    | 40 x 40 x 160 mm prisms, at 25 oC |
    | Age | At 25 oC (N/mm²) | At 30 oC (N/mm²) |
    | 1 day | > 35 | > 40 |
    | 3 days | > 55 | > 65 |
    | 7 days | > 60 | > 70 |
    | 28 days | > 80 | > 85 |
    | 91 days | > 85 | > 90 |
    | 50 mm & 75 mm cubes results |
    | Exposure classes: |
    | X0, XC1-4, XS1-3, XD1-3, XF1, XA1-3 |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
    Test method printed: (EN 1015-11)
    Test method printed: (ASTM
    Test method printed: C109/C109M; EN
    Test method printed: 12390-3)
2.8 Shrinkage.
    | < 0.015 % | at 91 days |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
    Test method printed: (ASTM
    Test method printed: C1090/C1090M)
2.9 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: SikaGrout®-9610 is supplied in special 25 kg bags and 500, 1000, 1500 kg big bags
    - Shelf life: 12 months from date of production
2.10 Storage conditions. Product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions away from direct sunlight and heat, not exceeding 40 oC. When stored under high temperature and high humidity conditions, the shelf life may be reduced.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (October 2025, Version 03.01) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (October 2025, Version 03.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Mixing ratio: 13.8 to 15.3 % water / powder ratio
    - Consumption: Approximately 500 liters per ton material
    - Layer thickness: 25 - 600 mm
    - Pot Life: 3 hours
4.3 Flowability.
    | Flow table | 270 - 330 mm |
    | Flow channel | > 550 |
    Test method printed: (ASTM C1437)
    Test method printed: (EN 13395-2)
4.4 Setting time.
    | Initial | Final |
    | 7 hours | 9.5 hours |
4.5 Notes on installation.
    - SikaGrout®-9610 has been especially formulated for use in specific applications. As such SikaGrout®-9610 should be installed by experienced fully trained contractors.
    - Sands or other products that could affect the products properties must not be added.
4.6 Equipment.
    | Mixer type | Paddle mixer |
    | Mixing time | Approximately 5 minutes |
    | Application method | One continuous pour |
4.7 Mixing.
    - SikaGrout®-9610 must be mixed using suitable grout mixing equipment combined with agitator for continuous large volume mixing. Volume capacity of equipment must be applicable to the volume of material being mixed for a continuous operation. Equipment trials must be considered to ensure product can be mixed satisfactory before full project application. Put most of the water required in the mixer and add slowly the grout material.
    - Mix until a homogeneous mortar (2 to 3 minutes), add the remaining water and continue mixing for at least another 2 minutes until the required fluid or flowable consistency is obtained. Mix with potable water only. Do not add more water than the maximum specified.
4.8 Cleaning of equipment. Tools and spillages can be cleaned with water while SikaGrout®-9610 is still uncured. Once hardened, the material can only be removed mechanically.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Material temperature. 2 °C min. / +40 °C max.
5.3 Ambient air temperature. 2 °C min. / +40 °C max.
5.4 Substrate temperature. 2 °C min. / +40 °C max.
5.5 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Density: 2.27 - 2.33 ton/m³ (EN 12390-7)
    - Compressive strength: Age | N/mm²; 1 day | > 35; 3 days | > 55; 7 days | > 60; 28 days | > 80; 91 days | > 85; 40 x 40 x 160 mm prisms, at 25 oC; Age | At 25 oC (N/mm²) | At 30 oC (N/mm²); 1 day | > 35 | > 40; 3 days | > 55 | > 65; 7 days | > 60 | > 70; 28 days | > 80 | > 85; 91 days | > 85 | > 90; 50 mm & 75 mm cubes results; Exposure classes:; X0, XC1-4, XS1-3, XD1-3, XF1, XA1-3 (EN 1015-11) (ASTM C109/C109M; EN 12390-3)
    - Modulus of elasticity in compression: > 30.000 N/mm²; Poisson's ratio: 0.20 (EN 12390-13) (ASTM C469)
    - Flexural-strength: > 11.0 N/mm² (EN 1015-11)
    - Tensile strength: > 6.0 N/mm² (ASTM C307)
    - Shrinkage: < 0.015 % | at 91 days (ASTM C1090/C1090M)
    - Bleeding: 0 % (No bleeding) (ASTM C940)
    - Chloride ion permeability: < 2000 (Low penetrability) (ASTM C1202)
    - Flowability: Flow table | 270 - 330 mm; Flow channel | > 550 (ASTM C1437) (EN 13395-2)
5.6 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.7 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaGrout®-9610, October 2025, Version 03.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/7/sikagrout-9610.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS SikaGrout®-9610, version 08/10/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/u/SDS%20SikaGrout%20-%209610%20GHS7.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
